name: Extensions grid (homepage 6)
description: Homepage section showing the first 6 extension nodes (sorted by title). Pulls live data via the list_extensions filter — kind, version, routes, tables — so editors only manage the extension nodes themselves.

field_schema.label: Eyebrow
field_schema.help: Small all-caps label above the heading. The design uses a §-prefixed phrase, e.g. '§ built-in extensions'.

Two-line section heading.
for the line break.

field_schema.label: Lead paragraph

field_schema.label: Bottom CTA

test_data.lead: Squilla ships with reference extensions that exercise every part of the extension API. They are not core code in disguise — they're the same gRPC plugins you'd build yourself.
test_data.heading:
Six extensions out of the box.
Built like a third-party would build them.
